cards.name: Context Distiller
cards.why: Choosing what an AI gets to see is the step nobody built a tool for. A workspace for picking, grouping and compiling that context into one plain-text message — locally, and never sent anywhere.

cards.name: Governance Framework
cards.why: Run several AI agents and they forget, contradict each other, and disagree about which file is real. Pinning the facts into files fixes what a smarter model cannot.

cards.name: Window Annotator
cards.why: Drawing on the thing you are looking at should not depend on the app supporting it. Hand-drawn marks pin to any Windows window and follow it as it moves, resizes and scrolls.

cards.name: Work Capsule
cards.why: Keeping work in sync across machines should not risk it. One click pulls, optionally commits and pushes every folder you chose — fast-forward only, never rewriting history.

cards.name: Pixel Panels
cards.why: The components this page is built from, lifted out and documented. One 2px grid, one embedded bitmap face, and the four rules that keep fourteen separate parts reading as a single instrument.

cards.name: DSH Universal Palette
cards.why: Three products with three different colour systems, and a designer retyping hex codes between them. One plugin turns whatever you are looking at into the palette you actually use.
